summary: All 8 acceptance criteria exercised: 4 backend test files (8 tests) + 9 browser checks (incl. 1 run against the public preview URL). All passed.

checks.criterion: Signup creates an isolated restaurant on a 7-day restricted trial
checks.name: test_tscheck_signup_trial.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/register -> 200, store_id != store-demo; GET /api/billing/me -> plan=trial, trial_days_left=7, limits.orders=20, limits.products=8; GET /api/orders and /api/products both return [] for the new store; duplicate email re-register -> rejected

checks.criterion: Signup creates an isolated restaurant on a 7-day restricted trial
checks.name: signup-creates-trial-store
checks.evidence: /register -> /dashboard shows 'Teste grátis: 7 dia(s)' banner for a freshly created store

checks.criterion: Signup creates an isolated restaurant on a 7-day restricted trial (public preview URL)
checks.name: preview-url-signup-trial-smoke
checks.evidence: Same signup flow run against https://brazil-feijoada.preview.emergentagent.com; trial banner visible on /dashboard

checks.name: test_tscheck_locked_features.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/whatsapp/chats on a trial store -> 403 {code: plan_required, required_plan: padrao}; unauthenticated request -> 401/403

checks.name: locked-feature-shows-upgrade
checks.evidence: New trial store: nav shows locked 'Atendimento WhatsApp'; /atendimento shows 'Disponível no plano Padrão' + 'Fazer upgrade' button which redirects to /planos

checks.name: plans-page-checkout-redirect
checks.evidence: /planos shows Básico R$49 / Padrão R$99 / Pro R$199; 'Assinar Padrão' redirects to checkout.stripe.com; /payment/cancel shows 'Pagamento cancelado'

checks.name: test_tscheck_master_panel.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/master/stores lists the freshly registered store; PUT /api/master/stores/{id} {plan: pro, status: active} -> 200; that store's GET /api/billing/me now returns plan=pro; non-master GET /api/master/stores -> 403

checks.name: master-panel-manages-stores
checks.evidence: master@pedefacil.com -> /master lists a freshly created store; changing its plan select to Pro shows 'Em vigor: Pro / Status: active'; Plataforma tab footer text + site URL saved and persisted after reload

checks.name: support-ticket-roundtrip
checks.evidence: Store admin opens a ticket at /suporte; master sees and replies to it in Suporte tab; store user sees the reply text and status 'respondido'

checks.name: caixa-gating-blocks-orders
checks.evidence: POST /api/day/close then /pedidos and /atendimento both show 'Caixa fechado' with 'Abrir Caixa' button; POST /api/orders -> 409; POST /api/day/open restores access; demo store caixa confirmed OPEN at the end (GET /api/day/status is_open=true)

checks.name: pedidos-page-full-flow
checks.evidence: Kitchen summary panel, type tabs (Todos/Entrega/Retirada), payment chips, status tabs incl. Em Análise/Cancelado all visible; created a new order via 'Novo Pedido'; opened its 'Mais' menu and 'Pix (QR Code)' dialog showing QR image + 'Copia e Cola'

checks.name: mesas-order-total-excludes-delivery-fee
checks.evidence: Added a tscheck table, launched Suco Natural 500ml x1, total showed R$ 8,50 (delivery fee excluded), sent to kitchen, closed the bill (table returned to 'Livre'), then deleted the test table (table list confirmed empty of the test row afterward)

notes: Did not touch the demo store's real WhatsApp connection per seed_facts (no Desconectar/Forçar Reconexão, no manual /atendimento messages, no simulate-message calls).
Caixa for store-demo was closed and reopened during the gating check; final state verified OPEN.
Cleaned up residual tscheck test tables from earlier iteration attempts via DELETE /api/tables to keep the demo store's Mesas view tidy.
Matrix has exactly 8 criteria; covered all 8 with a mix of backend (4 files/8 tests) and browser (9 checks, including the mandated public-preview-URL run).
